{{Quote|I received a personalized transfer offer from Major Yanus a few days ago; my time on Hoth flagged me as hostile-environment capable.|Raina Temple|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
'''Yanus''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who commanded the [[Toxi-Trooper Brigade]], a unit that specialized in operating in hostile-environment battlefronts such as the toxic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. Yanus sent a personalized transfer offer to [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Raina Temple]], who had been flagged as hostile-environment capable after serving on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], but Temple turned the offer down.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
